units.source_text: 他同父异母兄弟扭打在一起了。

en.t: He got into a scuffle with his half-brother.

units.source_text: 毫无疑问，正是因为他，他弟弟时常受到压迫。

en.t: There was no doubt that, because of him, his younger brother was often put under pressure.

units.source_text: 与此同时，他也因为弟弟而失去了自由。

en.t: At the same time, he too lost his freedom because of his younger brother.

units.source_text: 他的亲戚一直教育弟弟说：“你要跟哥哥学习。”

en.t: His relatives kept teaching the younger brother, "You should learn from your older brother."

units.source_text: 然而这相当于把他本人的手脚都束缚了。

en.t: But this was the same as binding his own hands and feet.

units.source_text: 他们扭作一团，终于滚到廊子旁边了。

en.t: They grappled together in a tangled heap and finally rolled over beside the veranda.

units.source_text: 他还记得，廊外的庭院中有一棵百日红，在阴沉欲雨的天空下，绽放着红彤彤的花。

en.t: He still remembered that in the garden outside the veranda there was a crape myrtle, blooming with bright red flowers beneath a gloomy sky that looked ready for rain.
